messages.content:
my background:

  • experience in CV, LLM, etc. Some experience in RL.
  • But has not modeled a decision system before. Don't know anything about PTCG before.

Below are my "imaginations". Still implementing and not sure if is helpful in RL training. I only confirmed chatgpt can implement rule-based agent with a specific strategy "quite well". Interpret with care and open to discussion.

One thing bothering me now is +ve teacher. eg my agent is beaten by an opponent agent. If I can get a human card player, he can come up with, say 100 solutions which i can coded into rule based agent. how to learn from these and avoid confusion in RL?

reference: RL learning from rule-based agent: https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/pokemon-tcg-ai-battle/discussion/717697
